This gives me everything I need. Here's the finalized specification:

```
## Module: sale_warehouse_auto_fulfillment
Per-warehouse automatic shipping, invoice creation, and invoice confirmation triggered by a single Sales Order confirmation.

### Models
- **stock.warehouse** (extended): auto_ship (Boolean, default False), auto_invoice_create (Boolean, default False), auto_invoice_confirm (Boolean, default False)
  - No new relations; fields live on the existing warehouse record, displayed next to the warehouse's short code (`code`).

- **sale.order** (extended, method override only, no new fields): overrides `action_confirm()`.
  - No new persisted fields. Reads `warehouse_id.auto_ship`, `warehouse_id.auto_invoice_create`, `warehouse_id.auto_invoice_confirm` at confirmation time.

- **ir.logging** (reused, not extended): automation failures are written here through a separate database cursor/transaction so the entry survives the rollback described below.

### Business Rules
- State flow unchanged: draft/sent -> sale -> (done). Automation is chained onto the existing `action_confirm()` transition, not a new state machine.
- Execution order on confirm, when warehouse flags are set: (1) standard order confirmation, (2) if `auto_ship`: validate the order's delivery in full — all lines, full ordered quantity, no backorder, no stock-availability check (negative stock allowed by design) — (3) if `auto_invoice_create`: run standard invoice creation, respecting each product's own invoicing policy (ordered vs. delivered quantities) exactly as the manual "Create Invoice" button does — (4) if `auto_invoice_confirm` AND an invoice was actually created in step 3: post that invoice.
- **"Nothing to invoice" is not a failure.** If step 3 produces zero invoiceable lines (e.g. a delivered-quantity-policy product with `auto_ship` off), invoicing is skipped silently, a note is added to the order's chatter, and the confirmation proceeds/succeeds normally.
- **`auto_invoice_confirm` has no independent effect.** It only posts an invoice that this same automation run just created. If `auto_invoice_create` is off, `auto_invoice_confirm` does nothing (there is nothing to confirm).
- **Failure handling (real errors only — delivery validation error, invoice creation error, invoice posting error):** the entire automation, including the order's state change to confirmed, runs inside one database savepoint. On any real error: roll back the savepoint completely (order reverts to quotation, no delivery, no invoice — nothing half-done), write a failure record to `ir.logging` via an independent cursor (so it survives the rollback), then raise a blocking `UserError` naming the stage that failed and the underlying reason (e.g. "Invoice could not be posted: customer has no receivable account") instead of the raw traceback.
- Serial/lot-tracked products are out of scope: if automatic delivery validation cannot complete because a lot/serial is required, this is treated as a real failure (full rollback + blocking message), not a silent skip.
- No per-order override and no exceptions list — every quotation confirmed from an automatic warehouse is automated the same way, no exceptions (explicit user decision).
- With all three warehouse flags off, `action_confirm()` behaves exactly as standard Odoo — the override is a no-op pass-through.

### Views & UX
- Form view (stock.warehouse, inherited): three checkboxes added next to the warehouse `code` field — "Ship Automatically", "Create Invoice Automatically", "Confirm Invoice Automatically".
- No changes to the Sales Order form, list, or Confirm button — automation runs invisibly behind the existing action. After confirm: delivery shows Done, invoice smart-button count increases, invoice shows Posted (or the order stays a quotation with a blocking error if something failed).
- No new menus, screens, wizards, or reports.
- OWL complexity: none — pure server-side Python logic on an existing method.
- No mobile-specific considerations (standard responsive form view).

### Security
- No new groups or access levels. Reuses existing Inventory (warehouse edit) and Sales (order confirm) permissions.
- No new ir.model.access.csv rows required — only existing models (stock.warehouse, sale.order) gain fields/method overrides; ir.logging already has its standard access.
- No new record rules; multi-company behavior follows the existing warehouse/order company scoping already in Odoo.

### Demo Data
- 2 warehouses: "Main Warehouse" (code WH) — all three flags ON; "Project Warehouse" (code PROJ) — all three flags OFF.
- 3 demo products: "Standard Widget" and "Office Chair" (in-stock, invoice policy = Ordered Quantities, sufficient on-hand qty for the happy-path scenarios), plus "Custom Fixture" (invoice policy = Delivered Quantities, used to demonstrate the silent-skip case when only `auto_invoice_create` is on).
- 5–6 draft quotations pre-created and ready to confirm, covering: (1) all flags on — full auto flow, (2) ship-only, (3) invoice-create-only (including one using "Custom Fixture" to show the silent skip), (4) all flags off on Project Warehouse — manual baseline, (5) an order for a product with zero on-hand stock on Main Warehouse — demonstrates negative-stock auto-shipment.

### Constraints & Notes
- No partial shipping: automatic delivery is always all-or-nothing for the whole order.
- No stock-availability check on automatic shipment — negative stock is intended behavior; only enable `auto_ship` on warehouses with trusted stock figures.
- No invoice emailing — invoices are posted, never sent.
- No log/report UI for automation history in the order itself; auditability is via `ir.logging` only (developer-facing), since a rolled-back order shows no trace of the attempt.
- Setting is strictly per warehouse; there is no per-order override or exception list.
```

module_summary:
{
  "summary": "Customization addon for sale_stock that adds three Boolean switches to stock.warehouse (auto_ship, auto_invoice_create, auto_invoice_confirm) and overrides sale.order.action_confirm() to chain delivery validation, invoice creation and invoice posting onto the existing Confirm button. No new models, menus, groups or record rules — behaviour changes only through _inherit on two models plus one xpath view inheritance on stock.view_warehouse. The whole automation, including the order's state change, runs inside one cr.savepoint(): a real error rolls everything back to a quotation, writes the failure to ir.logging through an independent registry cursor so it survives the rollback, and raises a UserError naming the failed stage and reason. 'Nothing to invoice' is explicitly not a failure — it is skipped silently with a chatter note; auto_invoice_confirm has no independent effect and only posts an invoice this same run created; with all switches off action_confirm() is a pure pass-through.",
  "risk_patterns": [
    "method override on sale.order.action_confirm wrapping super() inside cr.savepoint() — cache staleness handled with env.invalidate_all(flush=False) after rollback",
    "independent registry cursor writing ir.logging under SUPERUSER_ID — invisible to the caller's REPEATABLE READ snapshot, so UI-side verification requires a page reload",
    "stock.move.quantity assignment plus picked=True followed by button_validate with skip_backorder — button_validate may return an act_window dict, treated as a failure",
    "auto delivery bypasses availability checks and creates negative quants by design",
    "demo data writes to the pre-existing stock.warehouse0 record (renames Main Warehouse, flips all three flags)",
    "demo data creates a second warehouse (PROJ), which activates the multi-warehouse group and mutates user groups at install time"
  ],
  "critical_flows": [
    "Inventory > Configuration > Warehouses > Main Warehouse: the three checkboxes render next to Short Name and save correctly",
    "Confirm the 'Scenario 1' quotation on Main Warehouse: delivery smart button shows Done, invoice counter increments, invoice state is Posted",
    "Confirm the 'Scenario 5' quotation (Custom Fixture, zero on-hand): delivery is Done and product on-hand goes to -10",
    "Turn off Ship Automatically, leave Create Invoice Automatically on, confirm 'Scenario 3b' (delivered-policy product): no invoice, order confirmed, chatter shows 'Automatic invoicing skipped'",
    "Confirm the 'Scenario 4' quotation on Project Warehouse: standard Odoo behaviour, delivery stays Ready and no invoice appears",
    "Turn on only Confirm Invoice Automatically on Main Warehouse and confirm any quotation: nothing is automated (no delivery validation, no invoice)",
    "Force a failure (e.g. remove the customer's receivable account with all three switches on) and confirm: blocking dialog names the stage, order returns to Quotation, no delivery and no invoice remain",
    "Settings > Technical > Logging (developer mode), filter name = sale_warehouse_auto_fulfillment: the failure row from the previous flow is present after a page reload",
    "Open the Main Warehouse form as a user without Inventory admin rights: no AccessError, the checkboxes are simply not editable",
    "Confirm several quotations from the list view in one batch and verify each automated order completes independently"
  ]
}
critical_flows: Open Inventory > Configuration > Warehouses > Main Warehouse: three checkboxes (Ship Automatically, Create Invoice Automatically, Confirm Invoice Automatically) render next to Short Name field, toggle each, save, reload page, confirm state persists
Confirm Scenario 1 order (all flags on, Main Warehouse): delivery smart button shows Done, invoice smart-button count increments by 1, invoice state is Posted (not Draft), order state is Sale
Confirm Scenario 2 order (auto_ship=on, others=off): delivery shows Done, invoice smart-button is 0 or absent, no invoice created

Confirm Scenario 3b order (auto_invoice_create=on, auto_ship=off, delivered-policy product): order confirmed but no invoice created, chatter contains 'Automatic invoicing skipped' or similar, no error raised
Confirm Scenario 5 order (auto_ship=on, zero on-hand stock, Main Warehouse): delivery Done without stock check, product on-hand quantity becomes -10, order confirmed
Confirm Scenario 4 order on Project Warehouse (all flags=off): standard Odoo behaviour—delivery shows Ready (not Done), no invoice appears, order state is Sale
Enable only auto_invoice_confirm and confirm any quotation: nothing is automated, delivery and invoice unchanged from standard confirm, no side effects

Force failure scenario—remove customer's receivable account, enable all flags, attempt confirm: blocking UserError dialog names the failed stage ('Invoice could not be posted: …'), order reverts to Quotation, no delivery/invoice present, is idempotent on retry

Open Settings > Technical > Logging (enable developer mode), filter by name 'sale_warehouse_auto_fulfillment': failure record from previous flow is visible after page reload; timestamp and error message are populated
Log in as non-Inventory user, open Main Warehouse form: checkboxes are visible but read-only (grey), no AccessError or 403 raised, form loads cleanly

Bulk-confirm 5 draft quotations from Sales Order list view (Ctrl+click + Action > Confirm): each order processes independently—verify one failure does not cascade to others, and successful orders remain confirmed while failed order reverts

Confirm order with serial-tracked product line (auto_ship=on): UserError blocking message names 'Delivery validation' stage with product/serial details, order reverts to Quotation, no delivery created, ir.logging entry present after reload
risk_patterns: Savepoint + independent ir.logging cursor creates REPEATABLE READ snapshot race: logged failure may not be visible until page reload, and if logging fails silently, user sees rollback with no audit trail
Cache invalidation after cr.savepoint() rollback: env.invalidate_all(flush=False) must complete before raising UserError, or stale data leaks into error message (e.g. order state mismatch)

button_validate() returning act_window dict treated as failure: this is a control-flow signal (edit-inline wizard), not a real error—must verify it never triggers rollback on legitimate shipment completion

Invoice creation silent skip requires explicit chatter note: if auto_invoice_create=True and "nothing to invoice" condition hits (delivered-policy product, no delivered qty), chatter MUST log it or confirmation looks broken
auto_invoice_confirm has zero independent effect: enabling ONLY this flag does nothing; must verify UI/UX doesn't mislead users into thinking a lone flag is functional

Serial/lot-tracked products cause hard failure with full rollback: no graceful degradation—if any line requires lot/serial, entire order reverts to quotation; must verify error message names the product/stage

Negative stock allowed by design on auto_ship: if flag is accidentally enabled on a low-trust warehouse, overselling is irreversible; must verify warehouse-level access control prevents casual mutation
Demo data mutates pre-existing stock.warehouse0 record and adds user groups at install: not idempotent—re-installation may fail or behave unexpectedly; must verify install/reinstall sequence
View inheritance parsed as 'unknown' type: xpath location for three checkboxes next to 'code' field may target wrong element; verify rendered form has them in correct visual position

Permission model: warehouse checkboxes are security-gated on inventory group; non-privileged users must see read-only view with no AccessError, and privilege escalation via compute-field override is blocked
